claim_falsified: Every strictly self-consistent I_q^{-1}-Voronoi finite partition (each row strictly nearest its own centroid) is one-point exchange stable.

verification.notes: Scalar scores, uniform weights, weighted mean zero, all arithmetic in Fraction. Every row is strictly nearest its own cell centroid (in 1-D the I^{-1} metric is a positive scalar, so Voronoi = Euclidean), yet relocating moved_row to destination_cell strictly increases I_q. Hence Voronoi fixed does not imply exchange stable; the audited implication is strictly one-directional.
